QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Horntail's Dark Energy
QuestInfo.0: Gather vital information about Horntail from around Minar Forest, then talk to Eremos.
QuestInfo.1: Eremos and Surana have set up data collectors all over Minar Forest. You'll be able to analyze the energy generated by Horntail's influence if you activate them. Collect samples of Horntail's Evil Energy from monsters in Minar Forest, so you can analyze it with the Ryuul Data Collector.
QuestInfo.2: You've successfully used the data collector to analyze Horntail's energy.
